parameters.num_routes_k: <int> Number of bus routes operated during the service day.
parameters.num_trips_M: <int> Total number of bus trips to be served across all routes.
parameters.num_duties_N: <int> Total number of candidate driver duties available for selection.

trips.trip_id: <int> Zero-based identifier for this bus trip, ordered by departure time.
trips.route: <int> Index of the bus route on which this trip operates.
trips.departure_min: <int> Scheduled departure time of this trip, in minutes from midnight.
trips.duration_min: <int> Scheduled travel duration of this trip in minutes.
trips.end_min: <int> Scheduled completion time of this trip, in minutes from midnight.

duties: <list[list[int]], length num_duties_N> Each entry lists the trip_id values covered by that candidate duty, representing a feasible sequence of trips a single driver can perform.
costs: <list[float], length num_duties_N> Operating cost of each candidate driver duty.
